title: **The Prime-Embedded Scheduling Multiplicity Algorithm (PESMA) introduces prime-number encoding into the structure of scheduling algorithms, providing dynamic control over task prioritization, resource allocation, and multiplicity of task execution. Scheduling algorithms are essential for efficiently managing resources such as time, processors, and bandwidth in systems like computer networks, cloud computing, quantum systems, and manufacturing processes. By embedding prime-number modulation into the multiplicity of task scheduling, we introduce flexibility in handling task dependencies, overlapping tasks, and parallel execution, optimizing overall performance and resource utilization.**
